verdict.rationale: Pipecat is a voice-agent framework with a cloud deployment platform, so a scheduler for recurring jobs or sessions is a fair question to ask. The pack documents no cron, schedule, or recurring-trigger capability. The Cloud REST API starts agent sessions on demand and telephony sessions start from inbound carrier webhooks; both are one-off triggers, not recurring schedules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
